name: Should trim and interior woodwork be painted or stained?

mainEntity.name: Should trim and interior woodwork be painted or stained?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between painted and stained wood trim depends on your aesthetic preferences and budget. Painted trim, often made from paint-grade pine, poplar, or medium-density fiberboard (MDF), provides a clean, modern, or classic look that can brighten a room and is easier to touch up or blend with caulk. Stained wood showcases natural grain patterns and offers classic warmth, but it requires higher-grade hardwood, precise joinery without reliance on caulk, and a higher material investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painted trim offers a crisp look and easily conceals seams with caulk, while stained wood highlights natural wood grain but requires premium hardwood and tighter cuts.
